headline: Ramayana Day 14: ₹23.20 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana closed Day 14 on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at ₹23.20 Cr India nett and ₹27.65 Cr India gross, -18.9% from Day 13's ₹28.60 Cr. That day played on 22,289 shows at 18.8% occupancy. This is the closed day on the desk, not a live estimate.
body:
Through Day 15 the desk has Ramayana at ₹883.1 Cr India nett, ₹1,032.2 Cr India gross, ₹515.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹863.75 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, ENE Repeat at ₹5.85 Cr and Bachelor Party D'eux at ₹2.55 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. IMDb is citing about ₹650.0 Cr, Pinkvilla is citing about ₹1,000.0 Cr, India Today is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹883.1 Cr India nett and ₹1,547.2 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
